name: Trojan War
hook: The ten-year siege behind the Iliad, from Helen's elopement to the wooden horse.

facts.label: the Trojan Horse
facts.statement: The Trojan Horse was built by the carpenter Epeius as an offering to Athena; the Greeks hid inside and sacked Troy.

facts.label: Helen of Troy
facts.statement: Helen of Troy, the beauty Paris chose, runs off with him, starting the war; in Euripides' play only her phantom reaches Troy.

facts.label: Priam
facts.statement: Priam is the aged king of Troy and the father of Paris, Hector and Cassandra.

facts.label: Achilles
facts.statement: Achilles is the Greeks' greatest warrior; he kills Memnon and is killed by Paris's arrow to the heel, while his mother Thetis tried to burn away his mortality.

facts.label: the Iliad
facts.statement: Homer's Iliad begins in the tenth year of the siege; its title could translate as "Troy Story," and Shakespeare's Troilus and Cressida is set in the war.

facts.label: Heinrich Schliemann
facts.statement: Heinrich Schliemann argued Troy was at Hissarlik and later uncovered Mycenaean royal tombs at Mycenae.

facts.label: Cassandra
facts.statement: Cassandra, a daughter of Priam, has the gift of prophecy but is never believed when she foretells Troy's fall.
